summary: Iter 140 – Marketplace 'Comunicati stampa'. Backend: new pytest suite (16 tests, all pass) covering SA activation/deactivation, 403 when inactive, cross-org isolation (404 on GET/PUT/approve of another org's release/contacts), real AI generation (3 calls total: 1 API + 1 UI generate + 1 UI regenerate; output used only provided data, missing data listed), save/versions/approve/approval reset on edit, preview HTML, contacts CRUD with case-insensitive dedupe, CSV import (added/duplicates/invalid counts), legal basis required, export, search/filters, recipients count (excludes sospeso/opposto/no-basis), public unsubscribe -> 'opposto' and PUT cannot reactivate, settings (@crmevent.it rejected, verify-sender 400 'Brevo non configurato sulla piattaforma'), test email + send blocked while sender unverified, scheduled past date rejected, schedule/cancel, send now -> release ends 'errore' with error 'Brevo non configurato' (no crash), automations persist + validation, member role 'user' can read but all writes 403, cron 401/200. Frontend (Playwright): SA tab toggle with confirm works (activate/deactivate + search); QA marketplace card 'Attivo' + 'Apri servizio' link; inactive org sees 'Attivazione a cura del team CRMEvent' and /comunicati-stampa shows press-inactive; dashboard KPIs/table; new release dialog shows data + missing list, generation opens editor; save/approve/reset/regenerate/send dialog (counts, media filter, test-email error toast, send now -> 'Errore'); contacts add/dup/edit/import/search/export/delete; settings save/@crmevent.it reject/verify error/automation toggle persists after reload; member read-only UI; mobile 390px no horizontal overflow, dialogs full width. Existing test_press_mock.py FAILS ~75% (race condition, see backend issues). Cleanup done as requested.

minor.issue: Race condition: concurrent _sync_contact tasks (e.g. two contacts added quickly, or activation + first contact) both see no list and both POST /v3/contacts/lists -> duplicate Brevo lists per org. Reproduced by /app/backend/tests/test_press_mock.py: 'assert 2 == 1' at line 67 in 3 of 4 runs. Fix: per-org asyncio.Lock (or Mongo upsert 'creating' lock) around list creation.

tick() -> _sync_lists_retry() processes press_contacts of ALL orgs (no org filter, no service-active check). Running test_press_mock.py (which mocks Brevo and calls tick) against the real DB marked org_qa_eventi contacts 'sincronizzato' and wrote fake list_id 99/folder 7 into press_brevo_lists for org_qa_eventi. Scope the mock test (or the retry) to its TEST org; also skip orgs whose service is inactive.

If a list record with list_id exists it is returned without checking brevo_funnel.is_configured(); with Brevo key absent subsequent syncs call _request and mark contacts 'errore' instead of 'in_attesa'.

Editing an errored release resets status to bozza but leaves the stale 'error' field ('Brevo non configurato'). Also an 'errore' release keeps approved_at but cannot be re-sent/approved without an edit (no retry path).
When sender is verified but Brevo key absent, detail exposes internal message 'Invio di prova non riuscito: BREVO_API_KEY non configurata' to org admins; prefer a user-friendly message.

Enabling automation for an event that ended long ago immediately qualifies on next tick: AI draft generated (credit cost) with send_at in the past -> instantly approval_expired. Consider restricting to events ending after enabling or recent ones.

ui_bugs.issue: Release shows 'Errore' pill but the reason (rel.error e.g. 'Brevo non configurato') is never displayed in editor or dashboard, and no retry/send button is available.
Quote/photo inputs and 'Aggiungi citazione/foto' buttons are not disabled when locked (member role / inviato / annullato) unlike other fields.

issues: 'Comunicati' tab renders exactly the same component as 'Dashboard' (KPIs + same table) – no distinct list/filters
Send dialog uses native <select multiple> for media (requires Ctrl-click) and native datetime-local; automation uses native time input (shows 10:00 AM in en locale) – use shadcn components
Contacts table does not flag contacts with no legal basis (shown as 'Attivo' though excluded from sends)
Card badge says 'Prossimamente' while the service is available on request ('Attivazione a cura del team CRMEvent' only in detail)

action_items: Add per-org lock in press._ensure_list to prevent duplicate Brevo list creation (test_press_mock.py currently fails ~75%)
Scope test_press_mock.py tick/_sync_lists_retry to the TEST org (it pollutes real orgs' press_contacts/press_brevo_lists), and filter retry by active service
Show release.error in editor/dashboard for status 'errore' and provide a retry path; clear 'error' on edit
Disable ListEditor (citazioni/foto) when editor is locked
Optional: friendlier message on test email when Brevo key missing; replace native multi-select/datetime/time inputs with shadcn components
critical_code_review_comments: press._sync_lists_retry iterates all orgs without service-active check
SendDialog recipients useEffect ignores errors silently (count stays '…')
Editor preview uses window.open after an await – may be blocked by popup blockers (toast handles it)

rca of the issue: test_press_mock failure: add_contact spawns asyncio.create_task(_sync_contact) per contact; each calls _ensure_list which reads press_brevo_lists (empty), then lists Brevo folder lists (empty in mock) and POSTs a new list – two tasks interleave at the awaits so both create. Mitigation: asyncio.Lock keyed by org_id (single-process) plus re-read after acquiring; or atomic Mongo 'creating' flag.
